snippet.title: REANIMAL | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
REANIMAL is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S! Play in couch co-op, online co-op, or singleplayer!

In this new horror adventure game from Tarsier Studios, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

- Order Now -  
Steam: https://thqn.net/re-steam
PlayStation: https://thqn.net/re-psn
Nintendo: https://thqn.net/re-nsw2
Xbox: https://thqn.net/re-xbox
